ad_intro:
Plix (plixlife.com, Instagram: @plixlife) is a prominent Indian wellness brand with ~48 active creatives running across Meta in India, spending an estimated Rs.1-2 Cr/mo. Mid-scale D2C brand in the Wellness segment (est. from ad-spend ratios). Three obvious leaks in the funnel:

(1) Creative gap - heavy studio/offer creative with thin real-customer UGC, before/after or demo content. (2) Copy/CRO gap - headlines lead with price/offer rather than outcome, and ad traffic often lands on collections/offer pages rather than the exact SKU. (3) Tracking/retargeting gap - retargeting uses generic creative rather than staged, funnel-matched content; CAPI/return-event wiring is inconsistent. These are fixable in 7-14 days. We estimate 30-45% of ad spend is leaking; NURTURE - smaller budget with high-ROI quick fixes.

findings: Observed signal: Plant-protein static, taste-test UGC low. Creative leak (High): Ads lean on packaging/product shots + generic 'high protein' / 'transform yourself' headlines. Real 60/90-day transformation, taste-test, and 'how I use this daily' UGC is thin; before/after Reels drive highest ROAS in wellness.
Copy leak (High): Generic 'best protein' / 'X g protein' claims don't connect to lifestyle outcomes (post-workout recovery, fat loss, busy-morning smoothie).
Landing page leak (Medium): PDPs lead with product+offer; taste close-up, mixing demo, third-party lab-test badges, real transformation photos sit below fold. Sticky ATC lacks social proof.
Tracking & retargeting leak (Medium): Retargeting generic; flavour-specific audiences missing; subscribe-and-save / replenishment loops underused.
competitors: Strong category D2C peer running heavy UGC and SKU-direct routing.
Creative/CTR gap is the main opening.
Faster-growing challenger with rapid creative velocity.
Smaller budget winning on sharper creative.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: 25 Transformation + Taste-Test UGC Reels

25 Reels/month: real 60/90d transformations (fitness/energy/skin-hair), honest taste-test reactions (not scripted), how-I-use (post-gym shake, smoothie, office snack), founder/ingredient deep-dives. Expected: CTR +35-50%, CPA -20-30%.
WIN 2 - CRO: Demo + Lab-Test PDPs with Sticky Social Proof + Subscribe-Save
Mixing/demo hero video + third-party lab-cert badges above fold; sticky ATC with rating + 'X bought this week'; flavour bundles at 10% off; subscribe-save 15% off. Expected: CVR +25-35%, AOV +15-20%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: CAPI + Flavour-Specific Retargeting + Replenishment at Consumption Cycle
Flavour-specific retargeting; replenishment reminders at 20/40d (size-dependent) with subscribe-save; cross-sell stacks (protein+shaker+multi). Expected: repeat +20-30%, retargeting ROAS +50%.
